newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's leader to visit Washington to thank Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Peru's leader to visit Washington to thank Clinton.

text.p: Peru's President Alberto Fujimori will visit Washington in the next few days to thank U.S. President Bill Clinton for his support during the Lima hostage crisis, a senior government source said on Wednesday.
"He plans to go to Washington after his meeting in Canada with Japan's Prime Minister (Ryutaro Hashimoto) to give his thanks to Clinton," the source told Reuters.
He could not say if Fujimori would meet Clinton personally.

The Peruvian president has received a string of statements of support from the Clinton administration since Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels on Dec. 17 stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where they still hold 72 VIP hostages.
